deployment.message:
feat: Complete deployment notification system with comprehensive artifact tracking

 Major Enhancements:

Email Notifications:
- Rich HTML email templates with deployment summaries
- Comprehensive artifact details (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Cognito)
- AWS SES integration with fallback to file-based emails
- Professional styling with clickable links and infrastructure tables

Dynamic Configuration System:
- Centralized environment configuration (scripts/environment-config.sh)
- Dynamic domain generation based on environment
- Reusable functions for all deployment scripts
- Environment-specific feature flags and settings

Cognito Configuration Fix:
- Fixed placeholder client ID issues in deployed applications
- Dynamic frontend config updates with real Cognito values
- Environment-specific .env file generation
- Proper CI/CD integration for config updates

Enhanced Build Summaries:
- Fixed URL masking issues in build summaries
- Dynamic URL resolution (custom domain  CloudFront fallback)
- Comprehensive infrastructure metrics and artifact tracking
- JSON summaries for webhook integrations

Notification Integrations:
- Enhanced GitHub Actions workflows with email support
- Slack webhook integration with rich message formatting
- Microsoft Teams webhook support with action buttons
- Multi-channel notification system (Email + Slack + Teams)

Testing & Quality:
- Comprehensive unit test suites for frontend components
- Backend handler tests with proper mocking
- Enhanced test coverage and CI/CD integration
- ESLint fixes for cleaner code

Documentation:
- Complete GitHub secrets setup guide
- Email notification configuration guide
- Dynamic environment configuration documentation
- Deployment notification setup instructions

 Technical Improvements:
- Environment-agnostic configuration management
- Improved error handling and fallback mechanisms
- Professional email templates with mobile responsiveness
- Enhanced security with proper secret management
- Cross-platform compatibility improvements

 Key Features:
- Professional deployment notifications similar to GitHub's workflow emails
- Complete infrastructure visibility with all AWS service details
- Automatic SSL certificate management and custom domain setup
- Real-time deployment status with comprehensive artifact tracking
- Multi-environment support (dev/staging/prod) with dynamic configuration

This completes the transformation to a production-ready deployment system with
comprehensive monitoring, notifications, and professional-grade CI/CD workflows.
